messages.content: How many calories are in a tomato?

message.content:
A typical medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
If you’re looking at a smaller tomato (≈90 g) it’s closer to **16–18 calories**, and a larger one (≈180 g) will be around **30–35 calories**.  

These numbers are for raw, fresh tomatoes and can vary slightly depending on variety and ripeness.
